title: Audit launch readiness and revenue path
objective: Audit the complete EVOLUSA product against its documented MVP, launch checklist, technical architecture, compliance boundaries, and fastest credible path to first revenue. Produce a prioritized, evidence-backed execution plan without modifying production, running migrations, accessing secrets, publishing content, spending money, or contacting users.
acceptance_criteria: Current implemented product surface is mapped to documented MVP and launch checklist requirements.
All launch blockers are classified by product, UX, frontend, backend, database, security, compliance, growth, infrastructure, and operations.
Each finding cites repository evidence by file path and, when applicable, verification output.
A prioritized execution backlog identifies critical path, dependencies, risk, responsible agent, acceptance criteria, and revenue relevance.
A first-revenue plan defines target customer, offer, pricing hypothesis, acquisition channel, conversion event, and measurable launch metrics without making unsupported legal or regulatory claims.
No production change, migration, secret access, external publication, paid spend, outreach, merge, or deployment occurs.
Independent security, compliance, QA, and reviewer verdicts are recorded before completion.
evidence_required: Repository file-path evidence for every critical finding
escalation_triggers: A required repository, branch, service identity, credential, budget, production target, or legal interpretation is unknown.
Any step would require modifying or applying Supabase migrations.
Any step would require linking or deploying to Vercel or Supabase.
Any step would require secrets, client data, public publishing, outreach, spend, payments, permissions, merge, or production access.
Existing documentation conflicts materially with implemented behavior.
